resume_operation.in_sync: Resume at current revision answers ack with the durable revision; no redundant delta or snapshot sent
resume_operation.missed_moves: Resume after disconnect with missed moves returns bounded delta (moves slice) and authoritative snapshot; synchronizes state without reapplying moves
resume_operation.corrupted_ack_revision: Out-of-order or future ack_revision corrected with full authoritative snapshot at true revision; invalid delta not computed

http_snapshot_fallback.authorization: Requires participant actor; non-participants rejected with 403; returns authoritative durable match view
http_snapshot_fallback.nonconflicting: Unrelated HTTP paths (e.g. /healthz) untouched by the fallback handler

leak_free_lifecycle.teardown: Recovered sockets close cleanly; transport close removes request and upgrade listeners, empties connection registry, and releases advisory Redis routes
